blurb: The Old American Can Factory is an historic, six-building, 130,000 SF industrial complex in Gowanus, Brooklyn, housing a curated community of more than 350 persons including, artisans/fabricators, visual/performing artists, poets/writers/publishers, filmmakers/theater-makers, architects/designers, educators and others working in the culture industry.
